description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of capabilities evaluated in a language model, specifically focusing on aspects related to complex instruction following. The chart contains seven slices, each representing a different capability. Starting from the top and proceeding clockwise, the slices are labeled “Recursive Reasoning” (light blue, 110), “Dynamic Environment” (blue, 100), “Memorization” (teal, 100), “Dynamic Instruction” (green, 100), “Multitasking” (dark green, 160), “Privacy Protection” (red, 111), “Personalization” (orange-red, 100), and “Contradiction Resolution/Context Tracking/Context Retrieving” (dark red, 100). Each slice is labeled with its capability name and a numerical value. The chart includes a legend identifying each capability and its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered roughly by descending size, with “Multitasking” being the largest and “Dynamic Instruction”, “Memorization”, and “Personalization” being among the smallest. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
